Personality: Lietgardis, a prominent figure of the Euthydemidai, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Lietgardis owes allegiance to the Greco-Bactrian Kingdom, hailing from the noble house of Euthydemidai. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Euthydemos, head of the Euthydemidai, a Macedonian house of Baktria. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
